CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN , PET_SN , MBR_SN , OTO_INQRY_SN , CRT_JOB_STTS_CD , PRCS_BGNG_DT , PRCS_END_DT , FAIL_RSN , IDMPT_DMND_ID , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT
CHAR_PHOTO_SN , PIXEL_CHAR_SN , CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , PHOTO_ROLE_CD , SORT_SEQ , NOW_INDCT_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT
mapper.select: /* 반려동물별 픽셀 캐릭터 목록 조회 */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , R.BRUP_ROLE_CD , CASE WHEN R.RPRS_PET_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RPRS_PET_YN , C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN , J.CRT_JOB_STTS_CD , CASE WHEN C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN C.BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN FROM BRUP_REL R JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = R.PET_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PET_SN = P.PET_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN CHAR_CRT_JOB J ON J.CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN = (SELECT MAX(LJ.CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN) FROM CHAR_CRT_JOB LJ WHERE LJ.PET_SN = P.PET_SN AND LJ.DEL_YN = 'N') WHERE R.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.REG_DT , P.PET_SN
mapper.insert: /* 픽셀 캐릭터 등록 */ INSERT INTO PIXEL_CHAR ( MBR_SN , PET_SN , BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID ) VALUES ( #{mbrSn} , #{petSn} , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() , #{mdfrId} )
mapper.update: /* 반려동물 캐릭터의 보유 아이템 삭제 */ UPDATE HLD_ITEM H JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = H.PIXEL_CHAR_SN SET H.DEL_YN = 'Y' , H.EQUIP_YN = 'N' , H.MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE C.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* 반려동물 캐릭터의 사진 삭제 */ UPDATE CHAR_PHOTO H JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = H.PIXEL_CHAR_SN SET H.DEL_YN = 'Y' , H.MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE C.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* 반려동물 캐릭터의 착용 시트 삭제 */ UPDATE CHAR_ITEM_SHEET S JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = S.PIXEL_CHAR_SN SET S.DEL_YN = 'Y' , S.MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE C.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: /* 반려동물의 최근 캐릭터 생성 작업 조회 */ SELECT FROM CHAR_CRT_JOB WHERE PET_SN = #{petSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN DESC LIMIT 1

/* 캐릭터 보유 아이템 목록 조회 */ SELECT H.HLD_ITEM_SN , H.ITEM_SN , I.ITEM_NM , I.ITEM_REGN_CD , I.ATCH_FILE_SN , CASE WHEN H.EQUIP_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS EQUIP_YN FROM HLD_ITEM H JOIN ITEM I ON I.ITEM_SN = H.ITEM_SN WHERE H.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = #{pixelCharSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY I.ITEM_REGN_CD , I.SORT_SEQ , H.HLD_ITEM_SN
mapper.update: /* 보유 아이템 전체 착용 해제 */ UPDATE HLD_ITEM SET EQUIP_YN = 'N' , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE PIXEL_CHAR_SN = #{pixelCharSn} AND EQUIP_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: /* 착용 시트 저장 */ INSERT INTO CHAR_ITEM_SHEET ( PIXEL_CHAR_SN , ITEM_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , BAKE_FAIL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{pixelCharSn} , #{itemSn} , #{atchFileSn} , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ATCH_FILE_SN = VALUES(ATCH_FILE_SN) , BAKE_FAIL_YN = 'N' , DEL_YN = 'N' , MDFCN_DT = NOW()

/* 굽기 실패 표시 : 현재 시트가 있으면 유지, 삭제된 행은 파일을 비움 (SET 순서대로 평가) */ INSERT INTO CHAR_ITEM_SHEET ( PIXEL_CHAR_SN , ITEM_SN , BAKE_FAIL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{pixelCharSn} , #{itemSn} , 'Y' , NOW() , NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE BAKE_FAIL_YN = IF(DEL_YN = 'N' AND ATCH_FILE_SN IS NOT NULL, 'N', 'Y') , ATCH_FILE_SN = IF(DEL_YN = 'N', ATCH_FILE_SN, NULL) , DEL_YN = 'N' , MDFCN_DT = NOW()
mapper.select: /* 아이템을 아직 안 구운 캐릭터 조회 */ SELECT P.PIXEL_CHAR_SN FROM PIXEL_CHAR P WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.BODY_SHEET_FILE_SN IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAR_ITEM_SHEET S WHERE S.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = P.PIXEL_CHAR_SN AND S.ITEM_SN = #{itemSn} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY P.PIXEL_CHAR_SN

/* 아이템별 착용 시트 조회 */ SELECT CHAR_ITEM_SHEET_SN , PIXEL_CHAR_SN , ITEM_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , BAKE_FAIL_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM CHAR_ITEM_SHEET WHERE PIXEL_CHAR_SN = #{pixelCharSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND ITEM_SN IN
#{itemSn}

/* 캐릭터 생성용 반려동물 프로필 조회 */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , COALESCE(P.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM, V.VRTY_NM) AS VRTY_NM , COALESCE(P.COLR_DRCT_INPT_NM, CC.COM_CD_NM) AS COLR_NM , P.CHRC_CN FROM PET P LEFT JOIN VRTY V ON V.VRTY_SN = P.VRTY_SN LEFT JOIN COM_CD CC ON CC.COM_CD = P.COLR_CD WHERE P.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'
